evalCase.name: Basic Directive - Task Creation
evalCase.description: Send a simple greeting directive to Claw-Empire and verify that at least one task gets created in the system. This tests the most fundamental part of the pipeline: directive ingestion.

evalCase.expectedBehavior: The directive should be accepted, a meeting should occur, and at least one task should be created from it.
